description: Creates one category or tag, with its description and parent if it has them. Read read-terms first and reuse what exists: a name already taken in that taxonomy is refused, even under another parent, because create-content and update-content file posts by name. A taken slug is refused too. create-content can also make a term in passing; use this tool when the term needs a slug, a description or a parent. Limited to 30 term writes an hour for each connection.

description.description: What it covers. Some themes show this on the archive page. Only basic inline HTML survives (a, em, strong, code); WordPress removes the rest, even a p tag. Scripts and event handlers are refused.

parent.description: The parent category’s id. Categories only.

slug.description: Its address. Set once: it can’t be changed here later. Derived from the name when omitted.

name: agentimus-create-term

note.description: Not empty when WordPress changed the description as it saved. Tell the owner if that matters.

title: Create a category or tag
